topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I came home today, and there on the table was a stack of papers, neatly bound. Curiosity drew me to pick it up. It was a novel, and as I began to read, I realized it was about me. Every page, each character, reflected moments we shared, desires I never voiced. I didn't know what to think. It's as if every secret, every whisper, was laid bare, not just for him, but for anyone who might read it. I can't help but wonder why he chose to write these things down, to share the intimate parts of our life this way. I’m not sure how to face him now, not sure what to say.
